tapping the 3 (its round block is 40×32 px on screen) opened Blockly's own modal "Change value:" prompt (on a touch device Blockly edits numbers in a <dialog>, not in place): input 266×44 (18px, type text, inputmode null), OK 88×44, Cancel 88×44

tapping Motion again closed the palette (open: false); the scripts area is 679 px

the palette was scrolled 150 px by a vertical drag to reach its last block; a touch drag from the palette to under "stop motors" added "stop Left motor · A" (snapped under stop-before-wall:stop); saved (revision 3); the palette went back in as the drag began; the page never scrolled or zoomed over 19 samples
a touch drag of that block (grabbed on the block: true) onto the rail deleted it; saved (revision 5); the page never scrolled or zoomed
tapping "forward ▾" (98×36 px) opened a menu of "forward" 103×44, "backward" 103×44; tapping "backward" set backward

"+" then "Joystick drive": tabs Stop before the wall | Joystick drive (active); menu items stop-before-wall 276×67, joystick-drive 276×83, blank 276×51

the page never scrolled or zoomed during the joystick drag (19 samples) and no text was selected
holding ↑ selected no text and raised no callout
holding ↑ (48×44 px) lit it for 9 samples and drove 8.90 studs/s (wall 12.0 → 3.4); lifting stopped the motors
tapped "My world": the stage is in myWorld (props: none), the creation's run space is saved as myWorld
tapped "Test plate": the stage is in testPlate (props: wall), saved as testPlate
tapped "Back to build": Code view closed, stage closed, creation panel back; bricks, cables, device names and the creation exactly as built (run space testPlate → testPlate)
both programs kept: Stop before the wall r7, Joystick drive r0
no uncaught errors or rejections on the page

findings.detail: WebDriver typing into the focused prompt fired key events but inserted no text (still "3"); the 6 was entered with a script-dispatched input event, then OK was tapped. The software keyboard was not exercised (the simulator has a hardware keyboard connected).
